Use it for

  • Cement-based tile adhesives, grouts, screeds and renders, or any Portland cement product
  • Doorways, stairs, access ramps, repairs and shopping centres where a fast set is needed

Quick Set Water Approx. set time
300 ml 5.7 L 24 hours
1 L 5 L 3 hours
1.5 L 4.5 L 2 hours

Set times vary with the product you add it to, so always mix a trial batch first.

Before you use it

  • Don't use below 5 °C, or with reinforced concrete or metallic hardeners: it promotes steel corrosion
  • Shortens pot life and open time at normal and warm temperatures
  • May not be compatible with other additives
